identity.title: [v0.92][WP-18C.06] Build the operator attention inbox and intervention workflow

values.goal: Prepare an execution-ready, policy-governed operator attention inbox contract that agents can use without fabricating authority or flooding the operator.
values.required_outcome: A six-card, issue-specific, design-backed pre-bind package with exact ownership, bounded queue/authorization contracts, pairwise overlap notes, PVF lanes, negative proof, serial gates, and an execution handoff that remains blocked on #111/#112/#114.
declared_scope: Define a typed agent-to-operator attention request and transition contract.
Implement bounded Runtime queueing, deduplication, expiry, prioritization, grouping, retention, rate limits, quiet mode, and durable recovery after serial gates clear.
Integrate an authorized Observatory inbox with unread state, filters, deep links, lifecycle actions, and notification preferences.
Prove overload, spoofing, stale request, restart, reconnect, partial-write, corruption, expiry, and recovery behavior.
authority_boundary: Runtime owns identity verification, authorization, priority, ordering, expiry, lifecycle, retention, and receipts; browser state is projection only.
Source identity, urgency, reason class, and authority claims are derived or checked against #112 policy and never trusted from display payloads.
Operator responses are attention outcomes; no response grants approval or governance authority without a separate explicit authorized action.
This preparation may create cards/design and commit locally but may not bind, implement product code, publish, push, open a PR, merge, close, or mutate #83.
operator_constraints: Preparation worktree only under /Volumes/FastWork; root main remains inspection-only.
Use only C-SDLC v2 owner binaries and typed card editors.
Do not bind, implement product code, publish, push, open a PR, merge, close, or mutate #83.
Commit preparation artifacts and stop at the strongest truthful pre-bind ready phase.
